item.title: Akestlaos #1051 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasa
item.description: Akestlaos #1051 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Glaukgenes #8576 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The House of Chthonius
item.description: Glaukgenes #8576 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The House of Chthonius made room at the fire, but no one sat close.
